thread:
jen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — noise from the redis-eviction alerts is still higher than expected, saw 3x paging in the last 7 days. Can owners pick up the remaining action items?
jen: Query I used: `sum(increase(alerts_total{alertname=\"redis-eviction\"}[7d]))` -> 320 triggers last week (baseline ~110).
alan: I can take the dedupe work. Thinking we should group by `instance` + `region` and add a 5m suppression window.
raj: Happy to take thresholds — looks like some flaps happen at ~70% mem, spikes for short GC. Maybe change to `for: 2m` and threshold from 70% -> 85% for paging. Keep 70% as dashboard-only.
maria: I'll own paging policy changes and run a 48h canary (send to oncall-low, not primary).
jen: Thanks. Can we capture action items + deadlines here so SRE rotations know what to expect?
alan: Action: dedupe rule to aggregate by instance+region, suppression 5m. Owner: alan. ETA: Tue EOD (48h).
raj: Action: increase threshold for paging to 85% with `for: 2m`, keep 70% -> severity=warning. Owner: raj. ETA: Wed noon.
maria: Action: paging policy change — route redis-eviction -> oncall-low for 48h canary, then re-evaluate. Owner: maria. ETA: Wed 4pm.
jen: I'll update the postmortem tasks list and the tracking spreadsheet. Also want a follow-up check for recurrence patterns after 2 weeks.
alan: Quick config sketch (will PR):
```yaml
alert: HighRedisMemoryPaging
expr: redis_memory_used_percent > 85
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
  route: primary
annotations:
  runbook: ">> playbook link"
```
alan: For dedupe we'll add a metric label `instance_kv` to ingest pipeline so alerts coalesce at the instance level.
oncall-bot: Reminder: created task https://tasks.redwood.internal/RED-8917 for redis dedupe (owner: alan) :bell:
raj: I'll put together a short test harness to replay alerts from the last 30 days to validate dedupe and thresholds before we flip paging.
maria: Can we also add a short-term debounce in the routing layer to avoid multiple pages for a single failing node? even 90s would help.
alan: yes, adding `debounce: 90s` as a routing-level suppression in the canary.
jen: Owners: alan (dedupe + debounce), raj (thresholds + test harness), maria (paging policy + canary). I'll follow up with calendar invite for the 2-week recurrence review — tentatively Mon 2w from now.
raj: One more ask — if we move to 85% we should add one more evaluation window for 95th p99 memory per instance. I'll add that to my PR.
jen: Great. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:
alan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/ops/alerts/pulls/412 diff includes dedupe + debounce.
maria: Canary started (routing->oncall-low) at 2026-03-24T10:15Z. Will report on first 24h. :eyes:
jen: Noted. Closing out this thread for recording — will reopen if canary shows regressions. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
